name: Xunfei Healthcare Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Xunfei Healthcare Technology Co., Ltd. provides healthcare AI solutions in the People's Republic of China. The company offers primary solutions, including a general practice clinical decision support system (CDSS) and chronic disease management, which enables identification of key populations, one-click chronic disease screening and risk stratification, dynamic health monitoring, smart task reminders, and decision support during service delivery. It also offers smart hospital solutions, including smart service, smart healthcare, smart medical treatment combination, as well as the iFlytek Xiaoyi APP, an AI health assistant.
